Observe cancellation; abort in-flight page operation

bridgeTransports.parameters: bound engine and original owner identity

exposureFindings.finding: Work selects general profile and durable run lifetime. /chat serialization does not include a client capability manifest, preview support map, artifact-opening instructions or visible PTY identity.
exposureFindings.limit: Engine system prompt and tool registry may still add environment information; audit engine separately.

exposureFindings.finding: Built-in browser supports 15 model-side action values and connects for the active Work session even before browser view opens. Registration is gated by engine readiness, valid session and aiEnabled.
exposureFindings.limit: Static source does not prove the bridge was connected during the pasted session.

exposureFindings.finding: User PTY transport and engine command-job display/control are separate client APIs. No client-side bridge found that exposes window.aether.terminal as model tools.
exposureFindings.limit: Model command execution capability is resolved by backend inventory; this is not a claim that AI cannot run shell commands.

exposureFindings.finding: Office rich preview handles pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx; image/video/text/Markdown/HTML follow separate routes. Viewer capability is not a document-creation tool schema.
exposureFindings.limit: No runtime performance or rendering tests performed.

exposureFindings.finding: In addition to legacy session bridge, NativeBrowserHostManager registers host and accepts exact root-run demands, negotiating v2 browser clients with requestWatch/executionIdentity/resultMetadata. Work selection changes do not release these background roots.
exposureFindings.limit: Actual server protocol availability is not inspected.

exposureFindings.finding: Work artifact inventory derives from tool.change write receipts. SSE payload.fileChange associates with existing toolCallId. Ordinary Markdown names are not inferred as completed artifacts; clicked paths can create a synthetic path: resource to read.
exposureFindings.limit: Whether shell-created files emit changes is backend behavior; not established here.

exposureFindings.finding: Work preview DOM selection becomes explicit quoted text in the draft/message through workArtifactSelectionQuote; not an attachment. Whole-file reference becomes file Mention/path. Dedicated structured page/cell region metadata is not supplied on this generic Work path.
exposureFindings.limit: No live verification of selection in every document renderer.
